issue.title: RefsListScrollHostedTests.testHostedGrownContentAboveTopStillShowsTop marks the old first row as newly first
issue.description: Repo: bob-mac-capture. Proposing bead: bob-cli-a8 landing audit. CI assertion at line 59 says Optional(ref/papers/hosted_0.md) equals itself when the test expects a different first row. Exact root cause is in installScannedFixture: it marks listing.orderedIDs.prefix(3) as scanned, so the old first row remains first, contradicting the test's premise that new content was inserted above it. Correct the fixture to promote later rows into Just scanned, retaining assertions for top offset, changed first row, and selected first row. Reproduces in macOS CI runs 39499997621 at pre-epic 785508c, 39505351980, and 39511067813. Distinct from bob-cli-7h's inspector notes paging failures; this is the Refs list fixture. No causal active epic. Small because the fixture contradiction and narrow correction are verified in source.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical failure on three consecutive observed states: pre-epic 785508c (run 39499997621), e99cec6 (39505351980), and 1d5735a (39511067813). No passing rerun observed.

issue.creation_reason: Landing bob-cli-a8 revealed a repeatable pre-existing macOS CI failure that is not covered by the existing node-specific task scopes. Track it separately so the epic does not absorb unrelated baseline work.
